verdict.rationale: FireHydrant's Copilot proactively compares ongoing incidents to current and past incidents and posts suggestions in the Command Center and Slack, which covers the proactive similar-incidents part of the story. AI summaries are also generated as soon as an incident is declared. Change events can be recorded via fhcli, but nothing shows the AI correlating those changes or telemetry to produce a probable-cause hypothesis. missing for 10: AI correlation of recent changes/deploys with incidents, telemetry/observability analysis, explicit probable-cause or root-cause investigation output, independent or hands-on corroboration.
